title: The window leads with total dollars and points per merged PR
body:
Outcome: the first line of `krn ledger` is window total per merged PR, points per PR and the non-delivery share; the delivery-only figure follows.
Why: the $0.52 headline hides that four dollars in five merged nothing.
Proof: a test on a fixed window sees the three numbers and their sum to the cent.
Scope: `src/cli/ledger.ts`, `src/outcome/ledger.ts`, their tests. Under 1 point.
Program: .krn/runs/krn-program-v2/06-program.md section 2, slice S2.
Operator order 2026-11-10: "Odpalaj" (program v2 planned on Fable).
